distinguishes: The builder's view cuts a sender's run at its first transaction below the minimum tip, so a well-paying transaction behind a cheap one is not offered.

cases.name: a cheap transaction hides the ones behind it, at the builder's base fee
cases.derivation: At base fee 95 both effective tips are 5 and the earlier-received a0 goes first (BB-2). At 96 both are 4.
